description: This file defines a Validator class used for parameter validation within the OrangeHRM system's API v2. It includes validation logic, exception handling, and rules application for API request parameters.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class providing static methods to validate API request parameters against defined rules, handling exceptions, and cleaning input values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates given parameter values according to specified rules, throws InvalidParamException if validation fails.

methods.name: getOnlyNecessaryValues
methods.description: Filters the input array to exclude parameters based on rules' excluded keys, returning only necessary parameters.
